options.name: aap_hostname
options.description: URL to automation platform gateway. If value not set, will try environment variable C(GATEWAY_HOSTNAME), or E(AAP_HOSTNAME). If value not specified by any means, the value of C(127.0.0.1) will be used

options.name: aap_password
options.description: Password for your automation platform gateway. If value not set, will try environment variable C(GATEWAY_PASSWORD), or E(AAP_PASSWORD).

options.name: aap_request_timeout
options.description: Specify the timeout Ansible should use in requests to the automation platform gateway. Defaults to 10s, but this is handled by the shared module_utils code If value not set, will try environment variable C(GATEWAY_REQUEST_TIMEOUT), E(AAP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT)

options.name: aap_token
options.description: The automation platform gateway token to use. This value can be in one of two formats. A string which is the token itself. (i.e. bqV5txm97wqJqtkxlMkhQz0pKhRMMX) A dictionary structure as returned by the gateway_token module. If value not set, will try environment variable C(GATEWAY_API_TOKEN), or E(AAP_TOKEN).

options.name: aap_username
options.description: Username for your automation platform gateway. If value not set, will try environment variable C(GATEWAY_USERNAME), or E(AAP_USERNAME).

options.name: aap_validate_certs
options.description: Whether to allow insecure connections to automation platform gateway. If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. If value not set, will try environment variable C(GATEWAY_VERIFY_SSL), or E(AAP_VALIDATE_CERTS).

options.name: auth_type
options.description: Authentication type for this service cluster Defaults to JWT

options.name: dns_discovery_type
options.description: DNS discovery type used for this service STRICT_DNS (default) - Use, maintain and load balance among all returned addresses LOGICAL_DNS - Use the first returned address at a time See envoy documentation for further details

options.name: dns_lookup_family
options.description: DNS address selection control ALL - Use all addresses AUTO - IPv6 preferred

options.name: health_check_healthy_threshold
options.description: The number of consecutive successful health checks before a node is considered healthy.

options.name: health_check_interval_seconds
options.description: The time between health check requests.

options.name: health_check_timeout_seconds
options.description: The time to wait for a health check to complete.

options.name: health_check_unhealthy_threshold
options.description: The number of consecutive failed health checks before a node is considered unhealthy.

options.name: health_checks_enabled
options.description: If true, health checks will be used to determine if a node is healthy.

options.name: healthy_panic_threshold
options.description: The percentage of failed hosts when the proxy will panic and start routing traffic to all nodes. Set to 0 to disable this.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the AAP Service, must be unique

options.name: new_name
options.description: Setting this option will change the existing name (looked up via the name field)

options.name: outlier_detection_base_ejection_time_seconds
options.displayName: Outlier Detection Base Ejection Time Seconds
options.description: The base time a node will be ejected for.

options.name: outlier_detection_consecutive_5xx
options.description: Number of consecutive 5xx responses to consider a node unhealthy.

options.name: outlier_detection_enabled
options.description: If true, outlier detection will be used to determine if a node is unhealthy and should be ejected from the cluster.

options.name: outlier_detection_interval_seconds
options.description: The time interval between ejection analysis sweeps.

options.name: outlier_detection_max_ejection_percent
options.description: The maximum percent of nodes that can be ejected from the cluster.

options.name: service_type
options.description: Service Type for this cluster - name or ID Required when creating new Service Cluster

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the resource. Enforced state C(enforced) will default values of any option not provided.

options.name: upstream_hostname
options.description: If set, Server Name Identification(SNI) and host header are set to this value
